annotations.title: Reset Google Compute Engine virtual machine (VM) Instance

description: Resets a Google Compute Engine virtual machine (VM) instance. Requires project, zone, and instance name as input. Proceed only if there is no error in response and the status of the operation is `DONE` without any errors. To get details of the operation, use the `get_zone_operation` tool.

inputSchema.description: Request message for resetting an instance.

project.description: Required. Project ID for this request.

zone.description: Required. The zone of the instance.

name: reset_instance

outputSchema.description: Response message for resetting an instance.

operationName.description: The operation name of the instance reset.
